content:
morgan: CI red on nightly (arm64): `alloc_concurrency_test` is failing intermittently (2/20). Full build: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 — logs in /artifacts/12345/alloc.log. Can someone quick-bisect or kick a rerun?

ci-bot: Test failure detected: //runtime:alloc_concurrency_test — flaky threshold exceeded. Rerun available.

sam: I can take a look. Do we have a minimal repro command?

morgan: repro I used locally: `bazel test //runtime:alloc_concurrency_test --runs_per_test=50 --test_arg=--shuffle-seed=1234` — it sporadically hits an assertion in thread scheduling.

alina: FWIW I saw a similar flake last month that correlated with the new allocator patch (landing around commit a2b2c3d). Might be a scheduling/ordering assumption.

devon: Quick isolation tips: try `--test-threads=1` to rule out cross-thread interactions, and run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1 RUST_LOG=debug`. Also try `--runs_per_test=200` to increase signal.

sam: Can you kick a CI rerun with higher runs_per_test? @ci-bot rerun 12345 --runs 200

ci-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.internal/redwood/12346 — running 200 attempts on arm64.

morgan: thanks. If rerun reproduces, can someone start a `git bisect` between 7f3a1de..a2b2c3d? Suspect range is where allocator threading changes landed.

sam: I'll start bisecting. Local bisect workflow I use: 
```
git bisect start
git bisect bad a2b2c3d
git bisect good 7f3a1de
# run minimal test harness, mark good/bad
```
Run harness: `./scripts/run_alloc_test.sh --iterations 50 --shuffle` — it runs much faster than full bazel.

alina: Also add `--repeat=1` to rule out test harness flakiness (we saw harness retries masking ordering issues).

sam: kicked off bisect job on my laptop; if CI rerun reproduces I can escalate to bisect on CI to speed up.

nate: If you identify a culprit commit, please add the `test:flaky` label and ping QA so we can quarantine in the test grid.

sam: Update: CI rerun shows 7 failures in 200 runs (arm64). Bisect so far narrowed to commits touching `runtime/scheduler.rs` and `runtime/alloc.rs`. Running next candidate now.

morgan: great. if you need an infra VM with tooling, ping me and I'll spin one up.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: 200 attempts, 7 failures — artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/12346/artifacts

sam: Quick note: local bisect iteration suggests commit `c4f9d1b` introduces the race when tests are run with `--shuffle`. I'm going to open a draft PR reverting the small allocator reorder to verify.

morgan: :thumbsup: please include the failing log snippet in the PR and link the bisect commands.

nate: Thanks team. If PR lands, let's schedule a short post-merge check across x86 and arm64 nightly.

sam: Will do. I'll post a summary here once the PR is up and CI passes.

morgan: thanks everyone for the quick triage.
